name: 14: Overmind
storyline: Wake up to the chilling silence of a shattered cosmos. You are adrift in a graveyard of derelict ships, orbital bases, and drifting asteroids. Here, reality is broken: gravity shifts at a whim, space folds into impossible loops, and objects blink in and out of existence. Explore a vibrant, high-fidelity sci-fi world — from the colossal husks of derelict stations to ore-rich asteroid fields and forbidden tech. Within the ruins, you’ll face the "Machine Swarm," an alien force governed by a distorted spatial logic. The atmosphere is thick with mystery and tension: flickering anomalies, the skeletal remains of the Zirotech Corporation, and the haunting weight of isolation. Guided by your AI companion, S.A.M., you’ll piece together logs and fragments left by a fallen crew. Embark on a non-linear hunt for the truth: What fractured your memory, who triggered the extinction, and who are you when everything else is gone?
summary: 14: Overmind is an immersive first-person survival-adventure in an anomalous sci-fi space, where reality is torn apart by mysterious zones that alter the laws of physics. Waking up among ship wreckage with amnesia, you are a lone survivor with your AI companion S.A.M. Use high-tech exosuit and vehicles to gather resources, study all lost blueprints, and battle fractals from other dimensions. Will you unravel the mystery of your arrival and escape this hostile vacuum?
